title: Implement the reusable AWS command state stack
description: Implements story plx-21816d. Add a client-neutral CommandServiceStateStack under plexus/infrastructure/command_service. Provision a pk/sk DynamoDB table using on-demand billing, AWS-managed encryption, point-in-time recovery, deletion protection, and RETAIN; a standard SQS command queue with explicitly managed DLQ, encryption, retention, visibility, and redrive configuration; and a DLQ visibility alarm with optional operations-topic action. Expose stable resource attributes and outputs. Add CDK assertion tests, property validation, and a client-specific-value boundary scan. Do not add runtime adapters, Lambda, Fargate, API, dashboard, Celery, or legacy integration.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text:
Implemented the reusable command-service state stack within the bounded infrastructure scope. The stack defines a retained DynamoDB pk/sk table with on-demand billing, AWS-managed encryption, point-in-time recovery, and production-default deletion protection; retained SQS command/DLQ resources with managed encryption and configurable redrive settings; and an optional-topic DLQ alarm. Added strict validation, stable outputs/logical-ID coverage, public package export, and consumer/legacy-value scans.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text:
Review corrections completed: both queues now enforce TLS through generated resource policies, with synth coverage proving each policy denies sqs:* when aws:SecureTransport is false. The command queue now defaults ReceiveMessageWaitTimeSeconds to 20 for long polling, exposes a configurable receive_message_wait_time, and validates the SQS 0-20 second range.
